nullRetry.observation: An isolated production steering control retried 180 null paths in 180 ticks. Its scav was above the panic threshold, so this is not a normal full-AI freeze claim. The !path retry condition already existed at d19; the new stop behavior exposed it.
nullRetry.latestObservation: After cooldown and prefix changes, diffuse 227..474 ppm air over a 20 m route yields a safe partial path and actual full AI moves 4.0875 m in three seconds, with six searches and no panic. This limited success does not close the wall-detour failure below.

followupChanges.prefixCandidateCounts: The later actual-City search finding 0 null results out of 150 candidates must not be interpreted as 150 completed routes. The API now returns incomplete prefixes as arrays.

findings.shot: CPU wall-detour trajectory; no raster shot
findings.problem: With the current 700-node partial-path logic, a real scav advances toward a reachable target but stops at the nearest side of a wall. On the controlled 100 m floor with one 50 m wall, it stops changing position after 2.2667 s and remains 7.3168 m from the target at 90 s, with 160 null paths out of 164 searches, 14 ppm air, full HP and PATROL state. Changing only the diagnostic search budget to 10000 lets the same production actor/collision/AI travel 64.3441 m around the wall and reach the target radius at 46.3333 s.
findings.why: The new prefix can leave ordinary navigation unable to finish a physically reachable route that must first move away from the target. This defeats continued enemy pursuit or movement instead of merely slowing planning.
findings.hypothesis: Source-confirmed mechanism: the fallback chooses only an expanded node with strictly smaller heuristic distance than the start and returns null when best===start. At the local distance minimum beside the wall, the finite search cannot finish the long detour and refuses explored steps that initially increase distance; restarting the same search cannot retain progress around it.
findings.fix: Preserve bounded search/route progress through necessary detours without blind direct steering. Run node /workspace/scratch/0b7ad82bafe7/gas-wall-prefix-fix-probe.mjs and require the unmodified production-budget case to reach the 1.4 m target radius with real collision and no gas panic, while wall-collision and gas-cost constraints remain enforced; demonstrate bounded work and a real unreachable-target stop control.

realCityCorroboration.limit: The 10000-node City control also encountered a different physical obstruction, so only the controlled-wall test establishes complete physical reachability.

findings.refutation: Survived a separate frozen-source refutation. At the stopped point, the 700-expansion search retains 93 frontier entries but the best expanded heuristic distance equals the start distance (7), triggering best===start rejection. The 10000-node route starts by increasing that distance. Panic, patrol waiting, a stopped simulation clock and physical impossibility of the controlled wall route were refuted.
